title: List chat channels
description: Lists chat channels followed by the authenticated user, including direct-message channels.

title: Create chat message
description: Creates a message in a chat channel as the authenticated user.

title: List bookmarks
description: Lists the authenticated user's bookmarks.

title: List events
description: Lists upcoming events whose posts are visible to the authenticated user.

title: List categories
description: Lists the visible category hierarchy.

title: Create category
description: Creates a category and returns its ID, slug, and name.

title: Create group
description: Creates a group and returns its ID and name. Requires group creation rights.

title: Create post
description: Creates a reply in a topic as the authenticated user. When the site holds the reply for review, queued is true and the post ID is null. Do not submit a queued reply again.

title: Create private message
description: Creates a private message as the authenticated user.

title: Create tag group
description: Creates a tag group. Requires staff authority and tagging enabled. Tags use ID or name selectors; synonyms resolve to original tags. Name selectors require allow_tag_creation=true and may create tags. permissions maps group IDs to full or readonly; group 0 means everyone. Omitted permissions default to everyone/full.

title: Create theme
description: Creates theme metadata or a component. For additive styling use component:true, then attach with update_theme parent_theme_ids; enabled alone does not apply it. Standalone themes do not affect the default theme unless made default or selected by a user. For inline CSS/JavaScript prefer creating without fields, then discourse_set_theme_code using the returned code_revision. theme_fields is an advanced file/asset interface; do not invent upload IDs.

title: Create topic
description: Creates a topic as the authenticated user. When the site holds the topic for review, queued is true and the IDs are null. Do not submit a queued topic again.

title: Create user
description: Creates a user as an administrator. Registrations must be open. Supply the site's invite code if required and required user fields keyed by field ID. Missing-field errors identify the field name and ID.

title: Create webhook
description: Creates an administrator-only webhook, inactive with TLS verification enabled by default. Requires confirm_external_delivery=true. Activation, wildcard subscriptions, HTTP destinations, and disabling TLS verification each need their corresponding explicit confirmation. Select active event type IDs from the live catalog; wildcard and explicit event subscriptions cannot be combined.

title: Get current user
description: Returns the authenticated Discourse user, granted scopes, and MCP server URI.

title: Delete category
description: Deletes an empty category after confirming its current name.

title: Delete draft
description: Deletes one of the authenticated user's drafts at its current sequence.

title: Delete group
description: Deletes a group after confirming its current name. Administrators only. Automatic groups cannot be deleted.

title: Delete tag group
description: Deletes a tag group and its membership, permission and category relationships, including required-tag rules. Tags and topic tags remain. Requires staff authority, tagging enabled, confirm=true and the exact current expected_name.

title: Delete theme
description: Deletes a theme and its component links. Requires edit permission, the current name, and confirmation. Default and system themes cannot be deleted.

title: Delete webhook
description: Deletes an administrator-only webhook and its delivery history. Requires confirm_delete=true and the current destination fingerprint. This cannot be undone.

title: Filter topics
description: Discover topics through a filtered, top, or hot view. Filtered uses Discourse TopicsFilter syntax; top uses Discourse's top score and defaults to weekly; hot is daily top. Returns a uniform topic projection and truthful pagination metadata.

title: Get category
description: Reads category details needed for category management.

title: Get chat messages
description: Reads a bounded page of messages from a visible chat channel.

title: Get draft
description: Retrieves one of the authenticated user's drafts by key.

title: Get group
description: Gets safe details and caller capabilities for one visible group.

title: Get post replies
description: Read reply relationships for a post as recursive descendant IDs, bounded rich direct replies, or the upstream-bounded ancestor history. Preserves upstream ordering and references.

title: Get post revision
description: Returns a post revision visible to the authenticated reviewer.

title: Get Data Explorer query
description: Returns the definition of a saved Data Explorer query. Requires an admin account.

title: Get report
description: Retrieves one report from the caller's current report catalog. Requires staff access; admin-only reports and related items retain their normal restrictions. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and default to the last 30 days ending on end_date or today. Date ranges cannot exceed 366 days. Filters accept scalar values or arrays, as supported by each report. limit bounds rows only where the report supports it; omitting it preserves that report's default. cache opts into the existing report cache and requires administrator access; include_related_items defaults to false. This runs registered reports, not arbitrary SQL.

title: Get review queue count
description: Returns the number of pending reviewable records visible to the authenticated reviewer.

title: Get reviewable
description: Returns one visible reviewable with its current version, evidence, and available actions.

title: Get tag group
description: Reads tag-group configuration, including tags, parent, one-per-topic policy and permissions. Requires staff authority.

title: Get theme
description: Reads a theme or theme component and its fields. Requires administrator access.

title: Get topic view stats
description: Get up to 300 ascending daily topic view counts. Views combine anonymous and logged-in views; they are not unique viewers or an engagement judgment.

title: Get user
description: Reads a user profile visible to the authenticated user.

title: Get user moderation summary
description: Returns staff-visible moderation counters for a user.

title: Get user summary
description: Returns profile-visible aggregate activity for a user.

title: Get webhook
description: Reads safe webhook configuration for administrators. Returns destination origin and fingerprint, never the complete URL or signing secret. Relationship IDs are capped at 100 and report truncation.

title: Handle group membership request
description: Approves or denies one pending membership request for a group the authenticated user may manage. Approving adds the requester to the group.

title: Install theme
description: Installs executable theme code from exactly one repository URL or base64 archive. Requires administrator access and confirmation. Repository installs always run migrations and require confirm_run_migrations. Archive migrations are opt-in. Archive component imports default to none; merge and sync require run_migrations and confirm_run_migrations. Only archives can replace an existing theme; confirm its current name before replacement. Returns a theme summary without source code and reports any archive components that could not be imported.

title: Invite group members by email
description: Adds existing accounts that match an address and invites the rest to the forum with the group preassigned. Requires permission to view email addresses.

title: Invite to private message
description: Adds one user or group, or submits one email invitation, to a private message.

title: List authoring guides
description: Lists the local repository's authoring skills with descriptions and readable paths. Before authoring themes, styles, JavaScript, or other site code, find relevant skills here and read them with discourse_read_authoring_guide. Administrator only; requires the repository documentation to be installed.

title: List directory items
description: List user-directory metrics with authoritative totals and continuation. Supports Discourse periods, ordering, visible groups, page 0-10, and up to 50 rows.

title: List group members
description: Lists members and owners when the authenticated user may see them.

title: List group membership requests
description: Lists pending requests for a group the authenticated user may manage.

title: List group posts
description: Lists visible public-topic posts authored by members of a visible group.

title: List groups
description: Lists groups visible to the authenticated user.

title: List latest posts
description: List the site's latest visible posts using Discourse's fixed 50-post page and post-ID cursor. Results are a feed, not an exhaustive history.

title: List private messages
description: Lists a personal or group private-message mailbox visible to the user.

title: List reports
description: Lists the caller's available Discourse reports, including enabled plugin reports. Requires staff access. Use the returned report types with discourse_get_report.

title: List reviewable topics
description: Lists topic-level signals from pending reviewables visible to the authenticated reviewer.

title: List reviewables
description: Lists reviewable records visible to the authenticated reviewer, including their current actions.

title: List site settings
description: Lists admin-visible site settings while masking secret and credential-like values.

title: List tag groups
description: Lists staff tag-group inventory with permissions and parent tags, ordered by name and ID. Requires staff authority. Paginate with limit and offset; reads remain available when tagging is disabled.

title: List themes
description: Lists installed themes and components. Requires administrator access.

title: List user actions
description: Lists a user's visible activity using named action types.

title: List user posts
description: Lists a user's visible topics and replies with zero-based pagination.

title: List users
description: Lists and filters users visible through Discourse's staff user directory.

title: List webhook events
description: Lists administrator-only delivery history, newest first. Headers and bodies are omitted by default. include_content requires confirm_sensitive_content=true and mcp:private-messages:read because delivery bodies may contain private messages. Returns bounded JSON previews with current-configuration credential filtering; other sensitive forum or destination data may remain. Non-JSON and oversized bodies are omitted. content_limit bounds each preview.

title: List webhooks
description: Lists administrator-only webhook configurations, ordered by ID. Destination paths, queries, URL credentials, and signing secrets are omitted. Use the returned destination fingerprint for mutations. Relationship ID lists are capped at 100 and report truncation. include_catalog returns available event types and content types.

title: Manage group members
description: Adds or removes members of a group the authenticated user may manage. Provide exactly one of usernames, user_ids, or user_emails. The user_emails selector requires permission to view email addresses.

title: Manage own group membership
description: Joins a group that allows public admission, leaves a group that allows public exit, or requests membership with a reason.

title: Manage group owners
description: Grants or revokes group ownership. Adding an owner also adds them as a member. Automatic groups cannot be changed.

title: Manage user activation
description: Activates, approves, activates and approves, or deactivates an eligible user.

title: List notifications
description: Lists the authenticated user's notifications.

title: Perform reviewable action
description: Performs one currently available action on a visible reviewable after a fresh permission check.

title: Ping webhook
description: Queues a ping using the existing webhook delivery job and retry behavior, including for an inactive webhook. Requires confirm_external_request=true and the current destination fingerprint. Enqueue success does not mean delivery succeeded; inspect delivery history for the outcome.

title: Delete or recover own post
description: Deletes or recovers a post owned by the authenticated user.

title: Set post reaction
description: Adds, changes, or removes the authenticated user's reaction to a visible post.

title: Read authoring guide
description: Reads a bounded page of a local Markdown skill, companion reference, or developer guide under .skills/ or docs/developer-guides/, including untracked guides. Unlike source tools, guides do not require Git tracking. Paths are repository-relative; resolve links relative to the document's directory. Follow next_line for more. These are authoring instructions, not proof of installed runtime behavior. Local CLI commands described in guides are not available through this tool; report verification limits honestly. Administrator only.

title: Read post
description: Reads one visible post.

title: Read private message
description: Reads a private message visible to the authenticated user.

title: Read source
description: Reads a bounded page of a tracked code/documentation file from the site's core repository. Files are limited to 2 MiB; pages are limited to 256 KiB and 400 lines. Defaults to the reported Git revision with a commit-pinned GitHub reference. Optional working_tree mode is explicitly local, may differ from loaded processes, and has no matching public permalink. This is not shell access. Separate plugin checkouts and private configuration are unavailable. Administrator only.

title: Read topic
description: Reads a topic and a bounded set of posts visible to the authenticated user.

title: Read selected topic posts
description: Read exact, earliest, latest, around-post, or username-filtered topic evidence. Selection is bounded to 50 posts and reports the visible stream size without claiming the entire topic was loaded.

title: Redeliver webhook event
description: Makes one administrator-authorized redelivery attempt using the original stored headers and payload and the existing outbound SSRF protection. Requires confirm_redelivery=true, the current destination fingerprint, and expected_event_status. The event must belong to this webhook and must not be a ping or already queued for redelivery. May send private forum data to an external destination; no bulk redelivery or automatic retry is performed. In-progress native attempts block overlapping calls. A call after completion is a new attempt, so do not retry automatically after a timeout.

title: Reply to private message
description: Replies to a private message visible to the authenticated user.

title: Run Data Explorer query
description: Runs a saved Data Explorer query that the authenticated user can access.

title: Save draft
description: Creates or updates a draft for the authenticated user.

title: Search Discourse
description: Searches topics and posts visible to the authenticated user using Discourse search syntax.

title: Search posts
description: Search post-level evidence with Discourse query syntax. Preserves matched posts, highlighted excerpts, authors, topics, categories, and bounded continuation. This is keyword search, not semantic search.

title: Search source
description: Searches tracked source files for a literal string, with bounded results and line numbers. Defaults to the site's reported Git revision. Use discourse_read_source for surrounding code; choose working_tree explicitly to inspect local edits. Broad queries may require narrowing. Administrator only.

title: Search tag groups
description: Searches visible tag groups and visible member tags. Omits staff configuration. q and names combine; q supports SQL LIKE wildcards. truncated signals possible additional results.

title: Set theme code
description: Preferred tool for inline theme code. First get_theme and copy code_revision into expected_code_revision. Supply plain css and/or javascript strings; no field arrays, upload IDs, or numeric types. CSS replaces common/common.scss; JavaScript replaces javascripts/discourse/api-initializers/mcp-theme-code.js and should import { apiInitializer } from discourse/lib/api and export default apiInitializer((api) => { ... }). Each input accepts at most 65,536 characters. Omitted inputs remain unchanged; empty strings remove these managed files. Does not attach/enable a component. Checks compilation and rejects a code revision that has changed since your read. The revision check coordinates edits through this tool; it does not prevent concurrent edits through other interfaces. Read the returned verification; saved code is not browser-verified.

title: Close or reopen topic
description: Closes a topic with closed=true or reopens it with closed=false. Uses normal topic moderation permissions, status-change posts, timers, and staff logging. Returns persisted closed and archived state. Does not change archived status. Use this tool, not update_topic, to close or reopen topics.

title: Set topic pin
description: Pins a topic in its category, pins it globally, or unpins it. Uses normal topic pin permissions and status-change behavior. Category/global pins remain until unpinned; this replaces any existing pin expiration. Returns persisted pin state. Use this tool rather than update_topic for pinning.

title: Silence user
description: Silences a user for the requested duration, restricting posting while preserving login. Requires staff permissions, explicit confirmation, duration and reason. Uses standard silence audit/notification behavior without deleting posts; independent of reviewable status.

title: Set accepted solution
description: Accepts or unaccepts a post as the topic solution when permitted.

title: Source version
description: Reports the site's version, reported Git revision, local checkout revision, and whether tracked files have local edits. Use before inspecting source. Committed source is pinned to the reported revision, not latest main; this does not prove every running process has reloaded local changes. Administrator only.

title: Suspend user
description: Suspends a user, blocking login until the requested duration ends. Requires staff permissions, explicit confirmation, duration and reason. Does not deactivate the account or delete posts. Uses standard suspension audit/notification behavior; independent of reviewable status.

title: Sync remote theme
description: Checks a theme repository for updates or installs its latest code. Requires edit permission. Updating runs migrations and requires both code and migration confirmation. Checking also updates stored remote-version metadata. Returns a theme summary. When completing a pending installation, also reports skipped components with their errors.

title: List tags
description: Lists visible tags ordered by usage.

title: List topics
description: Lists recent topics visible to the authenticated user.

title: Set topic vote
description: Casts or removes the authenticated user's vote on a visible votable topic.

title: Unsilence user
description: Removes the user's silence using standard staff permission checks and audit/notification behavior. Requires explicit confirmation. Returns verified current state; already-clear restrictions are a no-op.

title: Unsuspend user
description: Removes the user's suspension using standard staff permission checks and audit/notification behavior. Requires explicit confirmation. Returns verified current state; already-clear restrictions are a no-op.

title: Update category
description: Updates basic details for a category.

title: Update group
description: Updates the group settings the authenticated user may change. Fields the user cannot change are ignored.

title: Update post
description: Edits a post when the authenticated user has permission.

title: Update site setting
description: Sets or resets one ordinary site setting after a current-value check and explicit confirmation.

title: Update tag group
description: Updates supplied fields, preserving omitted fields. tags replaces all member tags; [] clears them. parent_tag=null clears the parent. permissions replaces the full permission map. Synonyms resolve to original tags. Name selectors require allow_tag_creation=true. Requires staff authority and tagging enabled.

title: Update theme
description: Updates theme metadata, component relationships, or advanced files/assets when the authenticated user may edit it. Set component:true to convert an existing non-default theme in place, preserving its ID and code; conversion removes incompatible relationships and resets palette/user-selectability. Attach components using parent_theme_ids (full replacement list); child_theme_ids also replaces the full list, so preserve existing components. enabled alone does not attach a component. Prefer discourse_set_theme_code for inline CSS/JavaScript; it chooses canonical paths and checks revision and compilation.

title: Update theme setting
description: Sets a declared theme setting or restores its declared default. Requires edit permission. Use pipe-separated strings for list settings and arrays of objects for object settings. Reverting requires confirm and must omit value.

title: Update theme translations
description: Updates declared theme translations for one locale. Requires edit permission and the current theme name. Unknown keys reject the whole batch.

title: Update topic
description: Updates title, category, tags, or featured link when the user may edit the topic. Omit unchanged fields. To close or reopen, use discourse_set_topic_closed; to pin or unpin, use discourse_set_topic_pin.

title: Update user
description: Updates the authenticated user's own profile.

title: Update webhook
description: Partially updates an administrator-only webhook after checking its current destination fingerprint and active state. Requires confirm_update=true. Omitted fields are preserved. Relationship arrays replace their complete selections and require confirm_scope_replacement=true when changed. Clearing the signing secret requires confirm_clear_secret=true. Retargeting an active hook also requires confirm_external_delivery=true. Risky configuration changes require the same confirmations as creation. Clearing relationship arrays removes those delivery filters.

title: Upload file
description: Uploads base64 data or a remote HTTP(S) file for the authenticated user.

title: Upload theme asset
description: Uploads base64 asset data for use in a theme. Requires administrator access. Returns an unattached upload ID; use discourse_update_theme to attach it to a theme field. Site upload and MCP request-size limits apply.

title: Set user status
description: Sets or clears the authenticated user's status.

title: Discourse post
description: A post visible to the authenticated user.

title: Discourse topic
description: A topic visible to the authenticated user.

title: Draft a reply
description: Builds a prompt for drafting a grounded reply to a visible topic.

title: Research discussions
description: Builds a prompt for researching visible Discourse discussions.
